item.title: Pothole on the road sunk Marlow Road no 94, 15th August
item.description:

As a result, each time when bus 356 passes by into these potholes, it causes a noticeable vibration to travel directly into my first-floor flat.Please arrange an inspection to repair these potholes and restore a smooth road surface to resolve the traffic vibration issue. Thank you.
